modelOverview: The Datejust 41 is Rolex's 41mm interpretation of the classic Datejust, launched in 2016 to replace the Datejust II with slimmer lugs and a more refined profile. Every variant runs the modern automatic Calibre 3235 with a roughly 70-hour power reserve and offers a wide choice of dials, domed or fluted bezels, and Oyster or Jubilee bracelets. It is produced in Oystersteel, Rolesor (steel-and-gold) and solid gold executions, making it one of the most versatile watches in the Rolex catalogue.

126300.description: The all-Oystersteel Datejust 41 with a clean smooth domed bezel, offering the most understated and versatile expression of the model. Powered by the Calibre 3235, it is typically paired with an Oyster bracelet. Every example we offer is individually sourced and fully authenticated.
